services.name: Group Tours
services.desc: The Boyertown Museum of Historic Vehicles is housed in the former home of the Boyertown Auto Body Works which had continuous operations on this site from 1872-1990. services.name: Past Exhibitions
services.desc: A brief history of food trucks in the United States, from their beginnings as chuck wagons to their evolution into versatile, chic street food. Featured are numerous photos of Boyertown Auto Body Works trucks, which built a range of food trucks in the 1950s and 1960s, as well as the Museum's own 1958 Mister Softee ice cream truck. Featuring three custom built, one-of-a-kind cars, "One Hit Wonders of the Road" highlights exquisite craftsmanship found in unique vehicles that cannot be found anywhere else.
